review.why: Applies Strunk's composition rules and a list of AI-writing tics to prose, loading one section at a time.
review.summary: Summarizes Strunk's 18 rules of usage and composition, points to five reference sections with their token cost, and lists AI writing patterns to avoid (puffery, empty -ing phrases, promotional adjectives, overused vocabulary). It suggests a subagent copyedit when context is tight.
strengths: Loads one section (about 1,000 to 4,500 tokens) instead of everything
Concrete list of AI-prose tells to avoid
The rule summary is usable even without the files
cautions: The Strunk text and the AI-writing guide are in files not read here
A 1918 style guide, not tailored to reports or technical documents
